coffee-pub-crier.headingH1Crier-Hint: Configure the chat cards and sounds Crier uses to guide the table through combat.
coffee-pub-crier.headingH2Lifecycle-Hint: Whether combat beginning and ending are announced, and how those cards read. Rounds and turns are configured below.
coffee-pub-crier.headingH2Rounds-Hint: Control announcements posted when a new combat round begins.
coffee-pub-crier.headingH3simpleRoundStyle-Hint: Whether new rounds are announced, and the label, icon, theme and sound of the card when they are.
coffee-pub-crier.headingH2turns-Hint: Control the cards posted when each combatant's turn begins.
coffee-pub-crier.headingH3simpleTurnStyle-Hint: Whether turns are announced, and the label, icon, theme and sound of the card when they are.
coffee-pub-crier.headingH3simpleTurnElements-Hint: Choose which portraits, names, health details, effects, penalties, and other combatant information appear on turn cards.
coffee-pub-crier.headingH3MissedTurns-Hint: Configure GM-only reminders when a combatant appears to finish a turn without speaking in chat.
coffee-pub-crier.combatCardStyle-Hint: Theme used by combat start and combat end announcement cards.
coffee-pub-crier.combatIconStyle-Hint: Icon used by combat start and combat end announcement cards.
coffee-pub-crier.combatCards-Hint: Which ends of a fight get an announcement card.
coffee-pub-crier.combatStartSound-Hint: Sound played after the combat start card is successfully posted.
coffee-pub-crier.combatStartLabel-Hint: Text displayed on the combat start announcement.
coffee-pub-crier.combatEndSound-Hint: Sound played after the combat end card is successfully posted.
coffee-pub-crier.combatEndLabel-Hint: Text displayed on the combat end announcement.
coffee-pub-crier.roundCards-Hint: Whether to post a card when a new round begins.
coffee-pub-crier.roundCardStyle-Hint: Theme used by round announcement cards.
coffee-pub-crier.roundIconStyle-Hint: Icon used by round announcement cards.
coffee-pub-crier.roundSound-Hint: The sound to play at the beginning of each round. Note: if other modules play a sound at the beginning of the round, all sounds will play.
coffee-pub-crier.round-Hint: Text shown on round cards. Use {round} where the round number should appear.
coffee-pub-crier.turnCards-Hint: Whether to post a card when each combatant's turn begins, and how much it shows.
coffee-pub-crier.turnSound-Hint: The sound to play at the beginning of each turn. Note: if other modules play a sound at the beginning of the turn, all sounds will play.
coffee-pub-crier.turnCard-Hint: Text shown on turn cards. Use {name} where the combatant's name should appear.
coffee-pub-crier.portraitStyle-Hint: The image to show on the turn card. Choose from the token image, the token portrait, or none.
coffee-pub-crier.showBloodyPortrait-Hint: Lay a blood splatter over the portrait as the combatant takes damage. It gets progressively worse the more they have taken, and appears for whoever Show Health does.
coffee-pub-crier.obfuscateNPCs-Hint: Obfuscate names of certain combatants. GM will see names as normal with slightly altered turn card.

ObfuscateNPCsVisibility.Visible: Show if token is visible to a player
ObfuscateNPCsVisibility.Any: Player owned or token name visible

coffee-pub-crier.abilities-Hint: Show str, dex, con, int, wis and cha on the turn card.
coffee-pub-crier.activeEffects-Hint: Remind the table what's riding on this combatant — conditions, injuries, buffs, and other temporary effects, with severity and time remaining — and choose whose cards say so.
coffee-pub-crier.penalties-Hint: Under the effects, total up what they cost this combatant right now — roll penalties, and how long until they lift.
coffee-pub-crier.health-Hint: Show the health bar on the turn card, and the death saving throws once a character is down. Portrait blood follows this too.
coffee-pub-crier.missedTurns-Hint: Whether to tell the GM privately when a combatant appears to have finished a turn without acting, and how loudly.
coffee-pub-crier.DeathSaveNotYours: You do not own this character
coffee-pub-crier.Compact-Hint: Remove the speaker and timestamp from Crier announcement messages.
